scripts.check: pnpm run node-version:check && pnpm --filter backend... run build && pnpm run --no-bail --aggregate-output "/^(check:|test:app$)/"
scripts.ci:checks: pnpm run node-version:check && pnpm --filter backend... run build && pnpm run --no-bail --aggregate-output "/^check:/"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter backend... run build && VITE_API_BASE_URL= pnpm --filter frontend run build
scripts.dev: pnpm --filter backend... run build && node scripts/dev.mjs
scripts.deploy: pnpm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.test: pnpm run test:hooks && pnpm run test:lint-rules && pnpm run test:scripts && pnpm -r --if-present run test
scripts.test:feature: pnpm --filter backend... run build && pnpm --filter frontend exec vitest run
scripts.test:browser:install: pnpm --filter frontend exec playwright install --only-shell chromium

CALOCOUNT_SETUP_CODE.description: A long phrase that only you know, with **at least 12 characters**. On your first visit you type it to save your first passkey. Keep it safe: it also adds a new passkey if you lose your devices.

CALOCOUNT_OWNER_KEY.description: Keep `default`. It is the key of your data in the database.
